d: Three family members are stabbed and then burned; Miami detectives investigate the shooting of a young homicide witness.

st: Eye for an Eye; Dead End
d: A young man is shot to death in the middle of the street in broad daylight; a teenager's body is found in the passenger seat of his car.
A barrage of bullets from a machine gun leaves two young boys injured and a teenager dead; detectives resort to old-fashioned detective work to solve the case.
Firefighters discover a stabbed woman in a fire; a parking lot contains shell casings and a body.
A man is beaten to death in broad daylight; a murder victim may not have been the intended target.
A badly decomposed body; a corpse in an empty field.
